description: Defines an abstract class 'Upsert' for handling UPSERT (update or insert) database operations within Drupal, including methods for setting primary key, validation, and execution of the query.

classes.name: Upsert
classes.description: An abstract class for performing UPSERT operations, extending Query and using InsertTrait, with methods for setting primary key, validation, and execution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Upsert object with a database connection, table name, and optional options.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Sets the primary key or unique field for the UPSERT query.

methods.name: preExecute
methods.description: Validates the query before execution, checking for primary key, field overlaps, and presence of fields.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the UPSERT operation, preparing statement, executing, and returning affected row count.
